Vendor learning path

Blue Yonder Cognitive Solutions for planning and execution

Blue Yonder (formerly JDA Software, part of Panasonic) spans supply chain planning (demand, supply, S&OP, category and space planning) and execution (warehouse, transportation, order management, returns), now positioned as Cognitive Solutions on the Blue Yonder Platform. Many retailers know it first for demand forecasting and replenishment.

PlanningWMSOMSTMS

Learning path

Foundations

Beginner / BA
  • Planning vs execution and why both matter
  • Forecast → replenishment → purchase order
  • Warehouse execution basics
  • Returns and reverse logistics

Exercise. Explain how a promotion forecast should change orders to suppliers two weeks ahead.

Functional

Consultant
  • Demand planning hierarchies and causal factors (price, promotion, weather)
  • Replenishment parameters: service levels, safety stock, lead times
  • S&OP cadence and plan versions
  • WMS: slotting, wave planning, labour management
  • Order management sourcing and returns

Exercise. Tune safety stock for A, B and C items using different service levels.

Technical

Developer / Data
  • Loading history and master data: snapshots, deltas, reconciliation
  • Publishing planned orders back to ERP
  • Platform APIs and data sharing
  • Monitoring data quality that drives forecast accuracy

Exercise. Design the nightly flow from ERP/POS to planning and the morning flow of recommended orders back.

Architecture

Architect
  • Planning at different cadences: daily, weekly, monthly
  • Data platform integration and lineage
  • Execution resilience at the warehouse
  • Agents and automation boundaries: what may act without approval

Exercise. Draw the Blue Yonder planning → ERP execution loop (see integration scenarios).

Same concept, Blue Yonder vocabulary

Generic termBlue Yonder
Demand forecastDemand Planning (ML-driven forecasting)
Supply planSupply Planning / replenishment
S&OPSales & operations planning
WMSBlue Yonder Warehouse Management
OMSBlue Yonder Order Management
Automation orchestrationWarehouse execution (WES)
Data foundationBlue Yonder Platform and AI data cloud

Use cases

Demand-driven store replenishment

A grocer with short shelf-life products and frequent promotions.

Demand Planning forecasts by store and day with promotion effects; replenishment produces orders that ERP converts into POs and DC transfers.

KPIs: Forecast accuracy (WMAPE) · waste · on-shelf availability

Returns disposition at scale

E-commerce returns overwhelm a DC.

Returns rules decide restock, refurbish, return-to-vendor or liquidate; WMS processes return-to-vendor.

KPIs: Recovery value · returns cycle time

Integration surface

Blue Yonder Platform and AI data cloud; APIs and data integration for planning snapshots and execution messages; supplier and partner network capabilities.

Product names and modules evolve. Verify against current Blue Yonder documentation.
